newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean soldiers killed by landmine explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean soldiers killed by landmine explosion.

text.p: Two South Korean army privates were killed and five others injured on Thursday when landmines exploded in the southern part of the Demilitarised Zone bisecting South and North Korea, a military spokesman said.
They were repairing roads within an eastern area of the buffer zone at around 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) when an unspecified number of landmines exploded, the spokesman said.
"The exact cause of the explosion is not yet known. We don't know yet whether any of them touched the landlines," he said by telephone.
Three of the five survivors were badly injured and sent to a military hospital in the capital. Two others were treated at their camp, he said.
The spokesman declined to give more details.
South and North Korea remain technically at war since their 1950-53 conflict ended only with a ceasefire.
